name_reason: Already compliant. data_fd2_ prefix; domain 'animation' matches every sibling rodata table in anitab.c (data_fd2_animation_summon_radial_*, _variant_c_radial_5slot_*, _variant_e_16slot_*) -- the animation rodata-constant category, distinct from the BSS runtime-state vars data_fd2_battle_summon_anim_* at 0x540xx. Descriptor 'summon_variant_d_3slot_color_row_offsets' reflects purpose (per-color-index row y-offsets) and data type (offset table/array). '3slot' is the structural 3-active-slot descriptor matching reader fd2_tick_summon_anim_variant_d_3slot and sibling _16slot -- NOT address residue (address is 0x52511; no hex suffix present).
purpose: Summon-spell variant-D 3-active-slot animation: per-color-index row (vertical/y) offset table; entry value is added to the blit origin_y to place each color band of the effect.
logic_summary: Sole reader fd2_tick_summon_anim_variant_d_3slot (@0x272B8, summon-tick dispatch entry #7 of 10) REP-MOVSD-copies all 10 dwords (ECX=10 @0x272D2) into a local stack buffer var_38, then during TICK states adds local_offsets[color_idx] (color_idx cycles 0..9) into the sprite blit y-coordinate: origin_y + offset -> fd2_blit_indexed_sprite (ADD ECX,[ESP+EDX*4+0x8] @0x27456). For the enemy team (runtime_char[caster].bTeam==0) every entry in the LOCAL copy is shifted +0x82 (@0x272FA) to mirror the layout to the enemy side; the table itself is never written.
element_semantics: Each element is a SIGNED 32-bit vertical (row/y) pixel offset added to the animation origin_y, indexed by the variant-D color rotation index (0..9). Values {30,-10,70,20,100,130,40,80,110,60}; index #1 = -10 (0xFFFFFFF6) confirms signed.
notes: is_const verified by zero write-xrefs (only 1 READ + 1 base-addr DATA xref, both the MOVSD copy source in fd2_tick_summon_anim_variant_d_3slot) and the 'const' qualifier in src. Array boundary verified clean: Ghidra types it int[10] len=40 (0x52511..0x52538); next symbol data_fd2_animation_summon_variant_e_16slot_sprite_base_table at 0x52539 is a separate byte[16].
